title: Uniform junta node sample bound
statement: Let $n,k$ be nonnegative integers and let $\delta\in(0,1/2]$ be a failure parameter. The uniform node random-example bound is the maximum, over all sets $P\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, of the junta node random-example count for $P,k,\delta$.
caveat: The definition of the node random-example count is not supplied, so the bound is described in terms of that construction.
